scenario: 清分样本脱敏样例：卡档卡号改名为 card_num 后，先后与刷卡流水、优惠资格做两段等值 INNER JOIN

models.name: dwd_card_profile
models.description: 卡档整理：卡号 card_no 改名为 card_num
models.sql: SELECT c.card_no AS card_num, c.card_type AS card_type, c.holder_name AS holder_name, c.issue_city AS issue_city, c.status AS status FROM ods_card_info c

models.name: dwd_txn_with_card
models.description: 第一段连接：刷卡流水按卡号关联改名后的卡档
models.sql: SELECT t.txn_id AS txn_id, t.card_no AS card_no, p.card_num AS card_num, p.card_type AS card_type, t.amount AS amount, t.station_id AS station_id FROM ods_card_transaction t INNER JOIN dwd_card_profile p ON t.card_no = p.card_num

models.name: dws_txn_discount
models.description: 第二段连接：交易明细再关联优惠资格
models.sql: SELECT w.txn_id AS txn_id, w.card_no AS card_no, w.card_type AS card_type, e.discount_type AS discount_type, w.amount AS amount FROM dwd_txn_with_card w INNER JOIN ods_discount_eligibility e ON w.card_no = e.card_no

models.name: dws_city_discount
models.description: 同城优惠核对：卡号与发卡城市双等式连接（AND）
models.sql: SELECT p.card_num AS card_num, p.issue_city AS issue_city, e.discount_type AS discount_type, e.valid_to AS valid_to FROM dwd_card_profile p INNER JOIN ods_discount_eligibility e ON p.card_num = e.card_no AND p.issue_city = e.issue_city
